key.name: api-token
key.description: Personal API token to authenticate with Todoist REST API v2

key.name: show-current-task-in-panel
key.description: Whether to display the ongoing task title in the GNOME top bar

key.name: max-panel-task-length
key.description: Maximum character length of the task title shown in the top bar

key.name: current-task-id
key.description: ID of the currently focused or ongoing task

key.name: filter-query
key.description: Todoist query filter used to fetch tasks

key.name: show-task-labels
key.description: Whether to show Todoist labels or tags attached to tasks

key.name: show-task-project
key.description: Whether to show the project badge on tasks (e.g. #Eat the frog)

key.name: show-due-dates
key.description: Whether to show due dates on tasks

key.name: show-overdue-days
key.description: Whether to show the count of days a task is overdue

key.name: task-sort-order
key.description: Sort order for tasks: newest-first, todoist, priority
